svg.text: owner Vedam · Verilog-2001 · parameters: ROM_BASE, ROM_MASK, RAM_BASE, BANK_BASE (localparams)
Connects the Ibex instruction and data ports to ROM, RAM and the six register banks. Zero wait states; every address gets an answer.
sel, we, be, addr, wdata to 8
Windows: ROM addr[31:13]==0 · bank n addr[31:12]==0x10000+n · RAM addr[31:12]==0x20000 · else error. Instruction fetch only from ROM. No access may hang the CPU.
